components.css: .ds-navigation{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;font-family:var(--display,"Space Grotesk",sans-serif)}.ds-navigation a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text-soft,#c8cbd8);text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms}.ds-navigation a:hover,.ds-navigation a[aria-current],.ds-navigation a:last-child{color:var(--lavender,#c2c1ff)}.ds-navigation a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4d9fff);outline-offset:6px}.ds-navigation svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-navigation{gap:18px}.ds-navigation a{font-size:.8125rem}}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-navigation{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:4px 12px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-navigation a{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A personal, technical world built from dark navy, large sans-serif statements and native geometric compositions. The layout is spacious and asymmetric; professional supporting content remains quiet enough for the work to lead.

The expressive portrait is a true transparent cutout against a rotated violet plane. Project artwork has its own geometric vocabulary and is clearly identified as a concept or identity, rather than a product screenshot.
keyCharacteristics: Open typographic composition with alternating visual weight
Navy foundations with blue actions and lavender emphasis
Local display and mono fonts with restrained technical labels
Real portrait and native geometric project artwork
Small purposeful motion with a complete reduced-motion path

rules.name: The Accent Purpose Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies actions and small signals; lavender carries readable emphasis; violet is a graphic plane rather than a text surface.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the sans family for the human message and the mono family for technical supporting detail.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive link and button uses a blue (2px) focus outline with (6px) offset.

dos: **Do** preserve spacious asymmetry on desktop and a clear single-column mobile reading order
**Do** keep cutout imagery separate from readable captions
**Do** identify concept artwork explicitly and retain genuine project states
**Do** use small component or graphic motion with visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support
donts: **Don't** replace native project concepts with fabricated product screenshots
**Don't** turn status text or technical lists into decorative pills
**Don't** add generic shadows to a system whose depth comes from geometry and tone
**Don't** animate entire repeated project rows as a reveal pattern
